outcomes: Distinguish a field, a learning method, an architecture family and a generative objective.
Separate learned parameters from manually specified rules and inference-time inputs.
Fit a small numerical predictor and a count-based text model with independently checked outputs.
Choose and evaluate different AI components within one production workflow.
seo_description: Compare AI, machine learning, deep learning and generative models through explicit rules, a fitted predictor, a count-based text generator and production trade-offs.

references.title: Tom Mitchell: Machine Learning textbook and learning framework
Goodfellow, Bengio and Courville: Deep Learning introduction

examples.expected_output:
rule: priority
learned prediction: 9.000
generated: ai learns patterns

diagrams.title: Classify components along multiple axes
diagrams.body:
AI: broad task and system field
  |
  +-- Explicit rules, search and planning
  |
  +-- Machine learning: fit behavior from experience
        |
        +-- Deep learning: multilayer learned representations

Generative objective: model data or sequences so outputs can be produced.
It can be implemented with a simple count model or a deep neural model.
A product may combine several of these components.
